text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: pagerhook webhook POST to external-notifier returned 500 (x10) — pages queued but not acknowledged. Investigating.

sahana_oncall: saw this — I didn't get the page. manual page attempt returned "delivery failed".

matt.ops: checking logs now, looks like our outbound proxy to notify-api returned 502 for the last ~6 minutes. grabbing request ids.

devon_rotations: can someone manually ring the primary oncall via mobile? rotation service isn't showing a successful handoff.

eve_support: customer-facing note? support is seeing two high-sev tickets saying they didn't receive alerts.

tara_incidentlead: escalate to manual triage. matt, paste the error lines and a short mitigation we can run.

matt.ops: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T12:04:15Z ERROR notify-proxy POST /v1/notify -> 502 Bad Gateway id=4b7c2
2026-03-20T12:04:16Z WARN pagerhook retry=3 payload_id=xx-yy
2026-03-20T12:05:02Z ERROR notify-proxy upstream connection reset id=7f8a1
```

matt.ops: root cause looks like TLS handshake failures to notify-api in eu-west region. I can flip our fallback notifier to SMS for all pages in the next minute if we agree.

sahana_oncall: do it. manually paging via SMS is already starting. I'm on mobile for call.

devon_rotations: how to flip? command?

matt.ops: run control plane toggle —
```
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/flags/pagerhook/fallback \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"mode":"sms-only","ttl":600}'
```

tara_incidentlead: matt, please run and confirm. eve, prep a short status to affected customers: "Paging delivery delay; failover to SMS; oncall reachable by phone." Keep it <2 lines.

matt.ops: ran it at 12:06:30Z — controlplane returned 200. outbound pages now going to sms-notifier. confirming: last 30 messages show success codes.

incident-bot: Note: automation that posts to #incidents on oncall handoff is still failing due to webhook 500; handoffs will require manual confirmation until further notice.

eng-oncall: I'll open a quick hotfix to add retry/backoff and a circuit breaker metric. ETA 30m for patch and deploy.

sahana_oncall: good. tracking customer impact: 14 affected alerts (10 EU prod, 4 staging), contact list updated.

eve_support: sending the update now to active customers and CC-ing ops.

tara_incidentlead: tracker: https://rwd.internal/incidents/1765439876 — set severity P2 for escalation metrics. we'll reconvene after patch deploy. thanks all :phone: :white_check_mark:
